summary: A worker welcomes the new pay and says the worry is fewer shifts.
realLife: In one story a long-time fast-food worker said a raise from sixteen to twenty dollars was good for workers but feared cut hours. In another, a cashier at a big chain was overjoyed that a city raise would ease money stress, while owners around him said they would cut hours.
